_comment: Rooms and their player stations. Each station's id is RoomId + Number (e.g. A1). Colors match the station's LED strip. Add a second room here later for room-vs-room.
_audioComment: Speakers on the room's StarTech 7.1 USB card, played by the server (Windows must have the card set to 7.1).
Device = part of the card's name in Windows Sound settings (e.g. "StarTech"); empty = Windows default, skipping HDMI.
AudioOutput / Room / Attract / Sub = output on the card, 0-7, same numbering as the EscapeEngine (Sonic) AudioConfig:
0/1 green jack  (front L/R)   -> amp 1 -> Player 1, Player 2
2/3 orange jack (centre/LFE)  -> powered sub on 2 (centre, the plug's tip)
4/5 black jack  (rear L/R)    -> amp 2 -> Player 3, Player 4
6/7 grey jack   (side L/R)    -> amp 3 -> Room, Attract (outside)
Leave one out for 'no speaker'. A re-wire only needs these numbers changed; test each speaker on the Operator screen (/operator).
